rows.note: This is the standard all-purpose term for a web or information browser.

example.english: My phone doesn't have a browser, so how can I get online?
example.traditional: 我部手機冇瀏覽器，點上網呀？
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 lau4 laam5 hei3 dim2 soeng5 mong5 aa3

rows.jyutping: zaai1 tai2 m4 maai5 ge3 haak3
rows.note: Use this for a shopper who looks at goods but does not buy anything.

example.english: He's a browser who never buys; even after asking the price, he won't place an order.
example.traditional: 佢係齋睇唔買嘅客，問極價都唔落單。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 zaai1 tai2 m4 maai5 ge3 haak3 man6 gik6 gaa3 dou1 m4 lok6 daan1
